svg.title: How to read a Dühring chart (NaOH–water)
svg.text: How to read a Dühring chart (NaOH–water)
Lines of constant concentration are straight: T_solution vs T_water at the same pressure
Find the boiling point of pure water at the vapour-space pressure (steam table) and mark it on the bottom axis.
Go straight up to the line of the liquor concentration (here 40 % NaOH; interpolate between lines if needed).
Go across to the left axis. 4 Read the boiling point of the solution (here ≈ 197 °F).
BPR = T_solution − T_water. Because the lines are straight, two known points fix a whole line.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
